payload._note: N-able operates a two-tier business model where MSPs are the direct customers, and SMEs (small/medium enterprises <1,000 employees) are end-customers. No individual customer concentration disclosed at 10% threshold. NRR improved from 103% to 110% YoY. The company measures ARR by partner cohorts (partners with >$50K ARR grew 15.7% and now represent 56% of total ARR). Subscription revenue comprises 97.8% of total revenue. Geographic split: 48.8% US, 51.2% international in 2023.
